title: Deterministic template fallback runs through THE governed delivery-injection authority (delegated WOB-bound mission DL_4d48de10 no longer dies FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING)
description: Delegated WOB-bound missions (no pinned_plan_tasks/llm_plan) hit the deterministic template fallback in makeServePlanner, which on BASE cf2674c emitted T1+optional T2/T3 but NEVER a TELEGRAM_DELIVERY task and never reached the canonicalize injection seam -> assertPlanDataflow threw FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING -> PLANNING->FAILED (DL_4d48de10; reproduced live on BASE: [[T1 AUTOMATON],[T2 REASONING]] -> MISSING). Fix: extract true-omission injection into ONE helper injectDeliveryTaskForTrueOmission (forgery strip -> requested+zero-canonical+zero-raw -> executorCapSets servable -> producer-presence proof -> stamped push) shared by canonicalize seam AND template tail; template tail detects intent, injects, then reconcilePlanDataflow(telegramIntent/outputLanguage/input_artifact_sources) so the task gets identical canonical stamps. New typed code FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_INJECTION_NO_PRODUCER when no content-bearing upstream exists (never fabricate a deliverable). T2 stops embedding the goal verbatim (hygiene/semantic re-proofs; goal stays in mission_goal.txt via T1 worker_spec). No-intent goals: byte-identical BASE output. Not touched: declared_external_inputs, alias pinning, source-stamp inheritance, CAS namespaces, provenance architecture, coverage on template path, no fail-closed weakening. E1-E6 in pair-hotfix-d-delegated-delivery.test.ts: E1 BASE shape -> MISSING; E2 one canonical T3 w/ full stamps, gate passes; E3 RESULT_TEXT edge T2 only; E4 no-intent identical / UNSERVABLE / NO_PRODUCER / INVALIDATED / denied UNSENDABLE zero transport; E5 byte-identical replan + pinned verbatim replay; E6 delegated objective->workstream->WOB mission COMPLETED, one request, mocked receipt chatId=111 carrying real analysis.txt bytes. BASE-known failure reproduced identically on cf2674c: f4 R5.1-crash.
